item.title: A timeline of Nancy Guthrie's disappearance as search intensifies
item.description: The search for Savannah's Guthrie's mom, Nancy Guthrie, stretches into a fifth day after she disappeared over the weekend.

item.title: 2/1/2026: Minneapolis; The Far Side of the Moon; Boom Chicago
item.description: First, calls grow for an independent probe into Minneapolis shootings. Then, NASA's journey to the far side of the moon. And, the Amsterdam improv club behind comedy legends.

item.title: U.S. forces strike alleged drug boat in Pacific, second since Maduro's capture
item.description: The U.S. military struck an alleged drug-carrying boat in the Pacific on Thursday, marking the 38th vessel to be struck over the last five months and the second this year.

item.title: Nancy Guthrie "still out there," sheriff says, as FBI offers $50,000 reward
item.description: Investigators have no proof that the missing mother of "Today" show host Savannah Guthrie is still alive but are holding out hope she is "still out there," the sheriff said.

item.description: President Trump touts administration at National Prayer Breakfast; New book looks at the rise and political career of the late Sen. Harry Reid.

item.title: Los Angeles Rams quarterback Matthew Stafford named 2025 NFL MVP
item.description: Los Angeles Rams quarterback Matthew Stafford was named the NFL MVP, just edging out four other candidates that included New England Patriots quarterback Drake Maye and Buffalo Bills quarterback Josh Allen, last year's MVP.

item.title: The Hunt for Sarah Yarborough’s Killer
item.description: A high school student on her way to drill team practice is found murdered on campus. What it took to close the case after 30 years. "48 Hours" contributor Natalie Morales reports.

item.title: The Depraved Heart Murder
item.description: A surgeon is accused of drugging his girlfriend in order to control her. "48 Hours" contributor Nikki Battiste reports.

item.title: At least 3 dead, 6 injured when car crashes into Los Angeles supermarket
item.description: A Los Angeles Fire Department spokesperson said the crash at a 99 Ranch Market in Westwood is currently being investigated as an accident.
